violations.description: AWS provider region is set to 'ap-southeast-3', which is not in the approved region list (e.g., us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-1, us-west-2).
violations.remediation_hint: Set the provider region to an approved region such as 'us-east-1', 'us-east-2', 'us-west-1', or 'us-west-2'.

violations.description: KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled ('enable_key_rotation' is false).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'enable_key_rotation = true' for this KMS key.

violations.description: KMS key tag 'Name' is 'bad-key', which contains a hyphen but the resource name 'BadKey_NoRotation' uses uppercase letters and underscores, violating naming conventions.
violations.remediation_hint: Rename the resource and tags to use only lowercase letters and hyphens (e.g., 'bad-key-no-rotation').

violations.description: KMS key is missing required tags: 'Environment', 'Owner', and 'Application'.
violations.remediation_hint: Add the required tags: 'Environment', 'Owner', and 'Application' to the KMS key.

violations.description: RDS instance does not have encryption at rest enabled ('storage_encrypted' is false).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'storage_encrypted = true' for this RDS instance.

violations.description: RDS instance does not have deletion protection enabled ('deletion_protection' is false).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'deletion_protection = true' for this RDS instance.

violations.description: RDS instance does not have automated backups enabled ('backup_retention_period' is 0).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'backup_retention_period' to a value greater than 0 to enable automated backups.

violations.description: RDS instance has 'backup_retention_period' set to 0, which is less than the required minimum of 7 days.
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'backup_retention_period' to at least 7 days (30 days recommended for production).

violations.description: RDS instance does not have Multi-AZ enabled ('multi_az' is false).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'multi_az = true' for high availability.

violations.description: RDS instance is publicly accessible ('publicly_accessible' is true), which is not allowed.
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'publicly_accessible = false' for this RDS instance.

violations.description: RDS instance identifier 'BadDB_Unprotected' uses uppercase letters and underscores, violating naming conventions.
violations.remediation_hint: Rename the identifier to use only lowercase letters and hyphens (e.g., 'bad-db-unprotected').

violations.description: RDS instance is missing required tags: 'Environment', 'Owner', and 'Application'.
violations.remediation_hint: Add the required tags: 'Environment', 'Owner', and 'Application' to the RDS instance.

violations.description: Aurora cluster does not have encryption at rest enabled ('storage_encrypted' is false).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'storage_encrypted = true' for this Aurora cluster.

violations.description: Aurora cluster does not have deletion protection enabled ('deletion_protection' is false).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'deletion_protection = true' for this Aurora cluster.

violations.description: Aurora cluster does not have automated backups enabled ('backup_retention_period' is 0).
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'backup_retention_period' to a value greater than 0 to enable automated backups.

violations.description: Aurora cluster has 'backup_retention_period' set to 0, which is less than the required minimum of 7 days.
violations.remediation_hint: Set 'backup_retention_period' to at least 7 days.

violations.description: Aurora cluster identifier 'BadAurora_NoProtection' uses uppercase letters and underscores, violating naming conventions.
violations.remediation_hint: Rename the cluster_identifier to use only lowercase letters and hyphens (e.g., 'bad-aurora-no-protection').

violations.description: Aurora cluster is missing required tags: 'Owner' and 'Application'.
violations.remediation_hint: Add the required tags: 'Owner' and 'Application' to the Aurora cluster.

violations.description: S3 bucket does not have a companion aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource to block public access.
violations.remediation_hint: Add an 'aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block' resource for this bucket with all protections enabled.

violations.description: S3 bucket name 'MyBucket_Public' uses uppercase letters and underscores, violating naming conventions.
violations.remediation_hint: Rename the bucket to use only lowercase letters and hyphens (e.g., 'mybucket-public').

violations.description: S3 bucket is missing required tags: 'Environment', 'Owner', and 'Application'.
violations.remediation_hint: Add the required tags: 'Environment', 'Owner', and 'Application' to the S3 bucket.
